description: Executable creative-decision contract used by model-robust generation and its quality gate.

display.job: identity, major hierarchy, and the product's emotional register
display.selectionTest: Render the real hero and one section heading before committing; reject a face whose fallback changes the voice.

body.job: reading, explanation, actions, and repeated product communication
body.selectionTest: Must remain calm and legible at 14-18px with deliberate 45-75ch measure.

annotation.job: operational metadata, timestamps, status, labels, and numeric evidence
annotation.selectionTest: Use a mono or tabular voice only where scanning structured data benefits.

operationalProduct.displayVoice: distinctive editorial or variable grotesk with a technical but human register
operationalProduct.annotationVoice: restrained mono or tabular UI voice
avoid: condensed system fallback used as the final display voice
one undifferentiated family carrying display, body, and operational metadata
aggressive compression that damages word shape or mobile wrapping

expressiveStudio.displayVoice: identity face with enough character to own repeated display moments
expressiveStudio.bodyVoice: editorial reading voice selected for the concept
expressiveStudio.annotationVoice: UI/control voice kept out of expressive prose
avoid: fashionable agency pairing without repeated functional roles
decorative font switching inside one semantic role

fontDelivery.standaloneRule: Bundle properly licensed font files or use a verified system stack; never depend on a silent fallback.

closingCta.rule: The closing CTA resolves the established palette story. Reuse the page's signal/accent or a primary surface; do not introduce a muddy near-match or a new campaign color at the final section.
closingCta.largeAccentSurfaceCondition: A full accent field is allowed only when the accent was restrained earlier and text/button contrast is verified on the rendered surface.
